label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_other_01
text: Vaultin’ Veluza! Where?! Where in the world...?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_other1_02
text: You li’l flowers are gettin’ battered by the sea\nbreeze somethin’ fierce, but you don’t care![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_other1_03
text: What strong, pretty li’l flowers... Where?! Where\nin the world kin I go to find more like you?![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_other1_05
text: Oh, shoot! I need to get down to the market![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
